problem_text:
A manufacturing enterprise seeks to allocate its production batches from a set of seven distinct fabrication plants (denoted as F1 through F7) to seven regional distribution centers (denoted as D1 through D7). The objective is to minimize the aggregate handling and transit expenditure.

The production capacity at each fabrication plant is strictly limited as follows:  
*F1 can output 139 units.  
*F2 can output 192 units.  
*F3 can output 144 units.  
*F4 can output 79 units.  
*F5 can output 121 units.  
*F6 can output 196 units.  
*F7 can output 107 units.

Each distribution center has a predetermined order quantity that must be fulfilled precisely:  
*D1 requires 151 units.  
*D2 requires 174 units.  
*D3 requires 146 units.  
*D4 requires 109 units.  
*D5 requires 114 units.  
*D6 requires 4 units.  
*D7 requires 165 units.

The per-unit transfer cost, which incorporates logistics and processing fees from each plant to each center, is detailed in the table below:

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| F1        | 9  | 1  | 6  | 9  | 10 | 11 | 12 |
| F2        | 1  | 6  | 5  | 19 | 13 | 3  | 5  |
| F3        | 1  | 3  | 17 | 7  | 13 | 14 | 15 |
| F4        | 11 | 6  | 12 | 10 | 11 | 19 | 20 |
| F5        | 3  | 2  | 5  | 6  | 20 | 2  | 3  |
| F6        | 9  | 15 | 14 | 16 | 20 | 15 | 14 |
| F7        | 9  | 7  | 17 | 4  | 12 | 14 | 4  |

Determine the optimal allocation of production batches to distribution centers such that the total expenditure is minimized.
